name: Opening-range breakout
tagline: A TQQQ 30-minute opening-range breakout confirmed by gap, opening volume and ATR, with an ATR stop and a flat-every-night exit.
summary: Buys the first 1-minute close above the 09:30-09:59 range after 10:00, but only on gap-up sessions where opening volume is in a 0.7-1.6x band and the range is at most 0.6 ATR, then exits on a 0.55 ATR stop or at the close. Dev earns 17.89% CAGR / 21.38% DD / 1.02 Sharpe at 1 bp, less than half the 36.72% bar and only slightly below QQQ's 18.91%; the report calls it a negative result.
caveat: It fails because a long-only, flat-overnight TQQQ strategy forfeits the roughly 64% of TQQQ's log return earned overnight, and waiting for the 30-minute range leaves only about 0.23 pp of the average 1.29 pp up-day; at 5 bp CAGR drops to 11.33%.
